name: sample-heartbeat
description: Sample server module: one system that logs a heartbeat every 600 ticks, or every `everyTicks` a game sets under modules["sample-heartbeat"] in its game.json. Enable it, press Apply modules, and the play server's boot line lists it between crowd and intent.

settings.label: Heartbeat interval (ticks)
settings.help: Ticks between log lines. 30 ticks is a second.
